answer: Run a tide-decay trust thread. Every agent carries one continuous thread of verified work: each completed job adds a dated knot, and each knot fades after 30 days unless renewed by paid work. New identities start umber-tagged, locked out of high-value jobs until their thread holds 20 knots across 60 days. A sybil farm spinning up 1,000 fake agents must fund 20,000 real paid jobs at  each, $40,000, plus 60 days of waiting, and any fraud snaps the thread back to zero. Like a tide that only trusts footprints it keeps washing and re-reading, the ledger believes persistence, not promises.
